name: Love & Hauntings
source:
As you arrive in New Zealand, your mind is overwhelmed with conflicting thoughts. You hear voices in your head – and outside your head, too. Which voice will you heed?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
刚踏上新西兰的土地，纷乱交错的思绪便将你的脑海彻底淹没。你听见了脑海里的低语——也听见了来自外界的呼唤。你将听从哪一个声音？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
